```{r load }
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(harmony)
library(stringr)
library(UCell)
library(Azimuth)
library(cowplot)
library(ggplot2) # must be version 3.5.2
library(patchwork)
library(presto)
library(ggridges)
library(PNWColors)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(msigdbr)
library(PNWColors)

set.seed(123)

options(future.globals.maxSize = 8000 * 1024^2)

combined<- readRDS()
```

```{r annotate cell types with azimuth}

combined = JoinLayers(combined, assay = "RNA")
combined <- RunAzimuth(combined, reference = "kidneyref")

colnames(combined@meta.data)
pal <- pnw_palette("Starfish",15)

p1 <- DimPlot(combined, group.by = "predicted.annotation.l1", label = TRUE, label.size = 3, cols = pal) + NoLegend()
p1

p2 <- DimPlot(combined, group.by = "tissue_type", label = F)
p1 + p2
p1
```

```{r harlequin score}
Idents(combined)<- combined$seurat_clusters

# combining 3 best harl and pan 
markers<- list()
markers$harlequin<- c("RBRT14036", "RBRT3381", "RBRT94151", "PAN-HARL")

data.seurat <- AddModuleScore_UCell(combined, features = markers,
    ncores = 4)


hist(data.seurat$harlequin_UCell)

data.seurat<- subset(x = data.seurat, idents = c(0,1,3,6, 11,14, 7,10,12,19))
hist(data.seurat$harlequin_UCell)

pal <- pnw_palette("Starfish",10)
Idents(data.seurat) <- factor(
  Idents(data.seurat),
  levels = c( "6", "7", "10", "12", "19",  "14", "11", "0", "1", "3")
)

VlnPlot(object = data.seurat, features = "harlequin_UCell", idents = c(6, 0,1,3, 11, 14, 7, 10,12, 19), pt.size = 0, cols = rev(pal))
```

```{r pathway analysis based on harlequin groups}
Idents(combined)<- combined$seurat_clusters

# combining 3 best harl and pan in main tumor clusters
markers<- list()
markers$harlequin<- c("RBRT14036", "RBRT3381", "RBRT94151", "PAN-HARL")

data.seurat <- AddModuleScore_UCell(combined, features = markers,
    ncores = 4)

data.seurat<- subset(x = data.seurat, idents = c(0,1,3,11,14))

hist(data.seurat$harlequin_UCell)

data.seurat@meta.data <- data.seurat@meta.data %>%
  mutate(harl_group = ifelse(harlequin_UCell >= 0.25, "high", "low"))
Idents(data.seurat)<- data.seurat$harl_group


harl.markers <- FindMarkers(data.seurat, ident.1 = "high", ident.2 = "low" , min.pct = 0.25,test.use = "wilcox_limma")  %>% arrange(avg_log2FC) %>% mutate(id = row.names(.))


#### hallmark
msig_h <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H") %>%
  dplyr::select(gs_name, entrez_gene) %>%
  dplyr::rename(ont = gs_name, gene = entrez_gene)

gene_df <- bitr(rownames(harl.markers), 
                fromType = "SYMBOL", 
                toType   = "ENTREZID", 
                OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db)

# join entrez IDs back to DE results
harl_entrez <- harl.markers %>%
  mutate(SYMBOL = rownames(.)) %>%
  left_join(gene_df, by = "SYMBOL") %>%
  filter(!is.na(ENTREZID))

# create named vector of log2FC ranked by value
gene_list <- setNames(harl_entrez$avg_log2FC, harl_entrez$ENTREZID)
gene_list <- sort(gene_list, decreasing = TRUE)

msig_gsea <- GSEA(gene_list, 
                  TERM2GENE     = msig_h, 
                  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
                  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                  verbose       = TRUE)

msig_gsea

# plot
dotplot(msig_gsea, showCategory = 20) + ggtitle("harl expressor vs non-expressor (hallmark)")
```
